Startup overview / France · Pre-launch

Better project briefs.
More useful connections.

Un Coup de Pouce (UCP) is building a platform that connects homeowners with building and renovation professionals. Clearer requests, relevant introductions, and no commission on the work carried out.

Explore the concept↗Our planned AI use↗

The project
in one minute.

Who we serveHomeowners planning works, independent tradespeople and building companies.
ProblemUnclear requests make it harder to find suitable professionals and take time to qualify.
ProductA planned workflow for structured project requests, relevant professional applications and user-selected introductions.
Business modelProfessional subscriptions. No commission on the value of the work. Free use planned for requesters.
StagePre-launch. An initial technical base exists; product consolidation and testing are being prepared.
Legal statusFrench startup project. Not yet incorporated; incorporation planned in the coming months.
Initial focusA local validation phase around Toulouse, before considering wider coverage.

A useful
introduction.

Homeowners explain their needs.

The planned experience helps people describe the type of work, location, timing and practical constraints. Professionals can understand the request before deciding whether to respond.

Professionals choose their opportunities.

Tradespeople present their skills and service area, then apply to relevant requests. The homeowner chooses whom to engage with. Quotes, deposits and payments for the work remain directly between the parties.

The platform is not yet open. This website presents the intended experience; it does not offer live job requests, sign-ups or payments.

Why we want
to build with Claude.

Planned exploration — not integrated

Turn free text into a clear project brief.

We intend to explore the Claude API to structure a homeowner’s description, preserve their stated requirements and identify information that is still missing.

Ask useful clarification questions.

We want to help users explain their needs without requiring them to know technical trade vocabulary. Users would review and approve any proposed wording before it could be shared.

Make requests easier to understand.

We plan to assess summaries and request categorisation to help professionals qualify opportunities. Trade and location criteria should remain explicit and inspectable.

These are planned product capabilities, not deployed features. The interactive brief on the French homepage uses local, predefined rules and makes no AI API calls.

Evaluate first.
Keep people in charge.

Our proposed development approach starts with fictional examples, a non-AI baseline and human review. We would evaluate factual fidelity, missed constraints, unnecessary questions, correction effort, latency and cost per completed brief.

Before production, the integration would need server-side API access, data minimisation, output validation, prompt-injection testing, bounded requests and a usable fallback when the model is unavailable.

AI would assist communication. It would not certify contractors, diagnose building safety, guarantee project outcomes or make contracting decisions for users.

A model
built for clarity.

The planned pricing is €29 excluding VAT per month for an independent professional, or €20 excluding VAT per month plus €15 per linked tradesperson for a company account. Requester use is planned to be free.

There is no per-conversation charge in the current model and no percentage taken from renovation contracts. Contractual terms must be finalised before commercial launch.

Our growth approach is to validate the usefulness of introductions locally, then expand by trade and geography where evidence supports it. We are not claiming active customers, revenue, partnerships or measured traction.

Founder
& current stage.

Cosme Collomb · Project founder

UCP is a French startup project being prepared for market validation. An initial technical base exists. Its consolidation, verification and controlled testing are the next product milestones.

The company is not yet legally incorporated. Incorporation is planned in the coming months. This status is stated openly in our project presentation.

We are preparing to apply for startup support to explore and evaluate these AI use cases. UCP is not an Anthropic partner or an accepted Claude Startups member.

Current evidence and delivery limits are recorded in the public project progress tracker.
